name: Network Perimeter & WAF Defense
description: Edge perimeter analysis tracking web application firewall evaluations, rule group matches, and client geo origins.

queries.current_sql: SELECT count(*) AS metric_value FROM %catalog.waf_logs WHERE time_stamp BETWEEN :start_ts AND :end_ts
queries.previous_sql: SELECT count(*) AS metric_value FROM %catalog.waf_logs WHERE time_stamp BETWEEN :prev_start_ts AND :prev_end_ts
queries.sparkline_sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', time_stamp) AS bucket_ts, count(*) AS metric_value FROM %catalog.waf_logs WHERE time_stamp BETWEEN :start_ts AND :end_ts GROUP BY date_trunc('day', time_stamp)

queries.sql: SELECT action AS label, count(*) AS value FROM %catalog.waf_logs WHERE time_stamp BETWEEN :start_ts AND :end_ts GROUP BY action

SELECT client_ip_latitude AS lat, client_ip_longitude AS lon, count(*) AS count FROM %catalog.waf_logs WHERE time_stamp BETWEEN :start_ts AND :end_ts AND client_ip_latitude IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_ip_latitude, client_ip_longitude
SELECT client_ip, hostname, request_uri, rule_group, action, message, client_ip_country_code FROM %catalog.waf_logs WHERE time_stamp BETWEEN :start_ts AND :end_ts
